fix_hypothesis.observed_problem: Workers have previously returned incomplete research results before performing required source retrieval. At least one market execution successfully performed a public search, while the discovery AI execution returned without any source call.
fix_hypothesis.unknown_cause: No observed error or timeout explains the premature discovery return. Scheduling, orchestration, tool availability at the individual invocation level and worker completion behavior remain possible but unverified explanations.
fix_hypothesis.operational_solution: Implement an externally enforced completion gate with persistent candidate cursors and separate acquisition and analysis stages. A source-required assignment cannot transition to COMPLETED unless the controller observes an actual source-call receipt and a corresponding candidate assessment. If a worker returns without a required receipt, classify the assignment as INCOMPLETE_NO_SOURCE_CALL and retain the same pending action. The controller can then dispatch that exact action again or obtain the source evidence independently and deliver a compact analysis packet. A completed prefetched analysis must be classified separately from successful independent research.
fix_hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: If source acquisition is the principal operational bottleneck, matched prefetched assignments should achieve higher candidate-assessment completion rates than assignments requiring workers to initiate retrieval. If both variants return prematurely at similar rates, source acquisition alone does not explain the failure. If worker-initiated retrieval succeeds reliably but subsequent assessments remain incomplete, the bottleneck is downstream of source execution.

next_test.design: Run a controlled comparison with two workers, identical candidate identities, equivalent output requirements and matched execution budgets. Alternate assignment order to reduce order effects.
next_test.arm_A: Assign each worker one exact public source request followed by one candidate assessment. Independently record whether the requested tool call actually occurred, its response status and whether the assessment was returned.
next_test.arm_B: Supply both workers with the same immutable prefetched evidence packet and require both candidate assessments without tool calls.
next_test.arm_C: Repeat arm A with an external completion gate and persistent cursor. When a source-required response arrives without an observed call receipt, retain the unfinished action and classify the response as incomplete rather than completed.
next_test.sample: At least ten matched assignments per worker per arm.

fix_hypothesis.observed_problem: Workers can return a final diagnostic before executing a mandatory source action. Market NPC completed one search, whereas discovery AI returned without executing any source call. No observed error or timeout explains the latter.
fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Mandatory source execution is not sufficiently enforced by the current worker completion boundary. This is a testable workflow hypothesis, not an established internal platform diagnosis.

mechanism: Assign every required source action a unique dispatch ID and candidate identity.
Execute source acquisition as a separate controller-managed stage rather than relying exclusively on worker instructions.
Persist actual request parameters, response status, retrieval timestamp and response hash.
Provide workers with immutable evidence packets containing successful responses and explicit source failures.
Reject completed status when required source receipts or candidate assessments are missing.
Retain the exact unfinished cursor and retry only missing actions within a bounded retry budget.
Treat an actual source error as an attempted action, but never as successful evidence acquisition.
proposed_repair.limitation: Controller-prefetched evidence can improve reliable research coverage but does not demonstrate that workers independently execute public research. Independent worker source execution must remain a separate acceptance criterion.

next_test.falsification: If controller-managed acquisition does not reduce missing source receipts or incomplete candidate assessments relative to direct dispatch, the proposed workflow repair is insufficient. If complete prefetched packets still produce missing candidate assessments, an additional analysis or completion-validation problem exists. If direct dispatch consistently completes all required actions, the earlier failures are not reproducible under the tested conditions.

independent_worker_research.criterion: Workers must independently execute required source actions and produce externally verifiable receipts before completion. Successful analysis of controller-prefetched evidence does not satisfy this criterion.
